description: Redesign layout system (Sidebar, Header, AppLayout) with Premium AI Terminal aesthetic - dark glass sidebar with blue/purple borders and preserved green active state, transparent top bar, subtle space background in main layout. This feature applies the new design system from FEAT-001 to the core navigation and layout shell.
steps: 1. Read frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.css - current dark green sidebar with green active states

2. Update Sidebar.css background: .sidebar { background: rgba(19, 19, 26, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border-right: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); } for glassmorphism effect

3. Update Sidebar.css active navigation: .sidebar__nav-link--active { background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.08); color: #00ff88; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.15); } with subtle green glow and dark green translucent background - keep ::before accent line with green
4. Update Sidebar.css inactive hover: .sidebar__nav-link:hover { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.06); color: var(--color-text-primary); } for blue hover glow instead of generic card background
5. Update Sidebar.css branding area: ensure logo container has appropriate spacing, add subtle separator border using new border color
6. Read frontend/src/components/layout/Header.css - current dark background with green accents

7. Update Header.css: .app-header { background: rgba(19, 19, 26, 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); } for transparency and blue accent border
8. Update Header.css status indicator: keep green dot for online status (.status-dot with --color-accent-green), ensure clean modern icon styling

9. Update Header.css icon buttons hover: .header-icon-button:hover { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); color: var(--color-accent-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1); } for subtle blue glow

11. Update AppLayout.css: .app-layout { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 30%, rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.03) 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 70%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.03) 0%, transparent 50%), #0a0a0f; } to apply subtle space atmosphere - MUST be very dark, not distracting
12. Verify sidebar footer 'Developed by Orkun Acar' text is visible but understated (muted gray, small font)
acceptance_criteria: Dev server renders sidebar with dark glass effect, blue/purple borders, and green active navigation state
Top bar has transparent background with blue border accent
Main layout background shows very subtle space atmosphere (barely visible gradients)
Navigation remains fully functional - clicking links navigates correctly
Active page indicator (green) clearly visible on current route
All layout elements readable and properly spaced
verification: Start 'npm run dev' and open http://localhost:5173

Verify Sidebar: (1) Dark glass background with subtle transparency, (2) Blue/purple thin border on right edge, (3) Active navigation item has green background + green glow + green accent line, (4) Inactive items have muted gray text, (5) Hover shows blue glow, (6) Logo/branding visible at top, (7) Footer text 'Developed by Orkun Acar' visible at bottom
Verify Header: (1) Transparent background with blue border at bottom, (2) Online status shows green dot, (3) Icon buttons have clean appearance, (4) Hover on icons shows blue glow
Verify AppLayout: (1) Main content area has very subtle space background (inspect with DevTools to see radial gradients), (2) Background appears almost black to user, not distracting
Navigate between pages (Ana Sayfa, Maçlar, Tahminler) and verify active state updates correctly
